events.verdict: Murray (DEN) makes incidental contact with Kuminga's (GSW) hand that is considered part of the ball as he attempts his shot near the basket.

Replay review of the foul called on Looney (GSW) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Looney is not in a legal guarding position when he moves laterally across Murray's (DEN) path, initiating illegal contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) and Payton II (GSW) engage and disengage, allowing each other to move freely.
Jokic (DEN) briefly grasps Payton II's (GSW) arm as he attempts to establish a screening position, but does not affect his FOM.
Payton II (GSW) places both hands on Murray's (DEN) body as he releases but the contact is marginal.
Payton II (GSW) initiates contact with Gordon's (DEN) arm, which affects his shot attempt near the basket.
Anderson (GSW) places his forearm against Murray (DEN) with slight extension as Murray is off-balance, but he is able to move through the contact.
Jokic (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position during Kuminga's (GSW) drive to the basket before cleanly blocking the shot attempt.
Porter Jr. (DEN) extends a hand into Moody's (GSW) back, causing him to lose his balance.
Westbrook (DEN) is in a legal guarding position when Wiggins (GSW) loses his balance on his own.
Murray (DEN) steals the ball away from Wiggins (GSW) and any contact during the play is incidental.

Kuminga (GSW) initiates contact with Jokic's (DEN) head that affects his shot attempt near the basket. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul called on Kuminga does not meet the criteria for a flagrant foul.
Westbrook (DEN) legally contests Moody's (GSW) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Wiggins (GSW) briefly places a hand on Braun's (DEN) arm before immediately removing it as he pursues the loose ball.
As Braun (DEN) secures the loose ball, he never fully or clearly signals for a timeout and therefore a timeout is not recognized.
